title: Property suite: the journal invariants hold after every step of a random trace — after each append, torn-tail injection and writer restart the journal is re-read from disk and density must be exactly 0..n-1 (never a gap, never a repeat, across restarts and tear/recover cycles), injected garbage always isolates as a torn tail with the intact prefix returned while strict readers refuse loudly, truncation restores the exact pre-tear bytes byte-for-byte (not just event-for-event), every (seq,type,payload) round-trips after every op including unicode, nesting and empty payloads, two independent reads fold to identical replay state after every op, rewriting every ts on disk to a different wall-clock folds to the identical replay state and the semantic diff calls the shifted journal the same (replay is a function of events, never of the clock), reports carry no timings so the same seed always yields the same verdict while different seeds drive different traces, the zero-op run still verifies, and the CLI contract holds
task_text: hold journal invariants under random traces
